_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 3: the sound test, the password flow, encoder and apply ($822A-$8512). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: SOUND TEST (bank 3 slot `$801B` = `$822A`; from the reset check `$8341` of bank 0 with A + B held): stack
regions.description: `LDX #$FF / TXS`: the stack is reset - this screen never returns.

regions.name: SOUND TEST (bank 3 slot `$801B` = `$822A`; from the reset check `$8341` of bank 0 with A + B held): title
regions.description: `JSR $C06F` with the inline string `0A 20 88 'SOUND TEST'`: 10 characters at PPU `$2088`.

regions.name: SOUND TEST (bank 3 slot `$801B` = `$822A`; from the reset check `$8341` of bank 0 with A + B held): start at sound 1
regions.description: `$15` := 1 (the sound number) and the repeat counter `$14` := 1.

regions.name: SOUND TEST (bank 3 slot `$801B` = `$822A`; from the reset check `$8341` of bank 0 with A + B held): number position
SOUND TEST (bank 3 slot `$801B` = `$822A`; from the reset check `$8341` of bank 0 with A + B held): show the number
regions.description: `LDA $15 / JSR $C051` (`$E1CD`): the sound number is printed.

regions.name: SOUND TEST (bank 3 slot `$801B` = `$822A`; from the reset check `$8341` of bank 0 with A + B held): wait for a new press
regions.description: `JSR $C0E4` (`$DA8B`: one frame, the pads read, A = the NEW presses `$F5`); zero loops.

regions.name: SOUND TEST (bank 3 slot `$801B` = `$822A`; from the reset check `$8341` of bank 0 with A + B held): auto-repeat (not reachable)
regions.description: A non-zero `$F5` always goes to `$8265` (`$14` := `$0F`); the countdown `DEC $14` / `$14` := 2 below it is never reached, so **a held direction does not repeat**: a lead.

regions.name: SOUND TEST (bank 3 slot `$801B` = `$822A`; from the reset check `$8341` of bank 0 with A + B held): repeat counter
SOUND TEST (bank 3 slot `$801B` = `$822A`; from the reset check `$8341` of bank 0 with A + B held): store it
SOUND TEST (bank 3 slot `$801B` = `$822A`; from the reset check `$8341` of bank 0 with A + B held): Down: play
regions.description: Bit 2 of the new presses: `LDA $15 / JSR $C030` plays the sound; back to the wait.

regions.name: SOUND TEST (bank 3 slot `$801B` = `$822A`; from the reset check `$8341` of bank 0 with A + B held): Up: silence
regions.description: Bit 3: `JSR $C006` with `00 FF 7F`: a far call to bank 0 `$8000` (the sound engine's init: all channels silent).

regions.name: SOUND TEST (bank 3 slot `$801B` = `$822A`; from the reset check `$8341` of bank 0 with A + B held): on
SOUND TEST (bank 3 slot `$801B` = `$822A`; from the reset check `$8341` of bank 0 with A + B held): Left or Right
regions.description: Bits 1 and 0.

regions.name: SOUND TEST (bank 3 slot `$801B` = `$822A`; from the reset check `$8341` of bank 0 with A + B held): Left: sound - 1
regions.description: `DEC $15`; at 0 the number wraps to `$47` (71).

regions.name: SOUND TEST (bank 3 slot `$801B` = `$822A`; from the reset check `$8341` of bank 0 with A + B held): Right: sound + 1
regions.description: `INC $15`; at `$48` it wraps to 1: **the sounds are 1-71**.

regions.name: PASSWORD SCREEN, entry and flow (bank 3): set-up of the screen (`$82AC`)
regions.description: Sound `$1F` (stop the music); `SEI`; `JSR $C015` (`$D534`: all sprites hidden); nametable `$20` cleared (`$E445`) and its attributes (`JSR $C06C` with `40 23 C0 00`).

regions.name: PASSWORD SCREEN, entry and flow (bank 3): PPU control
regions.description: `$FF` := (`$FF` OR 8) AND `$DF`: 8 x 8 sprites from pattern table 1, and written to PPUCTRL.

regions.name: PASSWORD SCREEN, entry and flow (bank 3): the font tiles
regions.description: `$19:$18` := `$1010`; `LDA #$03 / LDY #$02 / JSR $C42` (`$D7F9`): bank 2 block 3 (the 15 map-quadrant tiles) armed for CHR `$1010`; then a far call bank 2 `$8012` (`02 11 80`): the font loader of bank 2 (probably set 2, the password screen's a-z, !, ?, umlaut dots and slashed zero; not isolated).

regions.name: PASSWORD SCREEN, entry and flow (bank 3): draw the grid
regions.description: `$19:$18` := `$2284`, X := 22, Y := 5: `JSR $8BB3`; then `JSR $8B7E`; sound `$19` (the password-screen music) and return.

regions.name: PASSWORD SCREEN, entry and flow (bank 3): wait for a button (`$82F6`)
regions.description: `JSR $C0E4`; a new A, B, Select or Start (`AND #$F0`) is needed, then `JMP $8B7E`.

regions.name: PASSWORD SCREEN, entry and flow (bank 3): entry: type a password (slot `$800C`)
regions.description: Called by the title screen's second-item mode and the boot (`$FF53` with `$2F` = 1). Sounds `$1F` and `$10`, the screen (`$82AC`), the field cleared (`$834F`), `$0400` := 1.

regions.name: PASSWORD SCREEN, entry and flow (bank 3): the editing loop
regions.description: `JSR $887F`: the cursor and character entry; **carry clear = a valid password** (decode, checksum or back door, see `$8516`).

regions.name: PASSWORD SCREEN, entry and flow (bank 3): invalid
regions.description: `JSR $876F`, wait for a button (`$82F6`), loop.

regions.name: PASSWORD SCREEN, entry and flow (bank 3): valid
regions.description: `$2F` non-zero: `JSR $8473` applies the decoded state; `JMP $8397`.

regions.name: PASSWORD SCREEN, entry and flow (bank 3): entry: show the password (slot `$8009`)
regions.description: Called by the progress recorder (bank 5 `$A2B9`, through `$8009`): the screen, then `JSR $83AE` (encode the game state), `JSR $860E` (turn it into the 32 characters of the field `$0411-$0430`), the field copied to `$0740` (for the compare), `JSR $866B`, `JSR $8711`; zero leaves.

regions.name: PASSWORD SCREEN, entry and flow (bank 3): edit mode
regions.description: `JSR $834F`; `JMP $8380` (the same editing loop, so the player can check the password).

regions.name: PASSWORD SCREEN, entry and flow (bank 3): clear four text rows (`$834F`)
PASSWORD SCREEN, entry and flow (bank 3): (second row)
regions.description: `JSR $C06C`;

regions.name: PASSWORD SCREEN, entry and flow (bank 3): (third row)
regions.description: `JSR $C06C`;

regions.name: PASSWORD SCREEN, entry and flow (bank 3): (fourth row)
regions.description: `JSR $C06C`;

regions.name: PASSWORD SCREEN, entry and flow (bank 3): clear the field
PASSWORD SCREEN, entry and flow (bank 3): edit loop: finished?
regions.description: `JSR $8711`; zero leaves.

regions.name: PASSWORD SCREEN, entry and flow (bank 3): edit loop: mode
PASSWORD SCREEN, entry and flow (bank 3): edit loop: draw the cursor
regions.description: `JSR $8B7E`.

regions.name: PASSWORD SCREEN, entry and flow (bank 3): edit loop: input
regions.description: `JSR $887F`: carry set (a button other than the grid) goes to `$838E` (`JSR $87B5`), otherwise `JSR $87F2` (a character chosen).

regions.name: PASSWORD SCREEN, entry and flow (bank 3): edit loop: wait
PASSWORD SCREEN, entry and flow (bank 3): leave the screen (`$8397`)
regions.description: Sprites hidden, sound `$1F`, the fade out (`$C0ED`), PPUCTRL restored (`$FF` AND `$F7`, OR `$20`: 8 x 16 sprites): `RTS`.

regions.name: PASSWORD ENCODER (`$83AE`): copy the state
regions.description: `$0438 + Y` := `$049F + Y`, Y = 17..1: **index i (0-16) = the byte `$04A0 + i`** (the item flags `$04A0-$04A8`, the corridor-cleared flags `$04A9-$04AB`, the weapon levels `$04AC-$04AE`, the Eraser stock `$04AF`, the keys `$04B0`) lands at `$0439 + i`.

regions.name: PASSWORD ENCODER (`$83AE`): chip level in byte 8
regions.description: The chip level `$46` is shifted bit by bit into `$0441` (the copy of `$04A8`) from the bottom, four times: **`$04A8` keeps only its low nibble (item flags 64-67), moved up; the chip level takes the bottom nibble reversed.**

regions.name: PASSWORD ENCODER (`$83AE`): byte 14
regions.description: `$0447` (the copy of `$04AE`) AND `$7F`: **bit 7 is not saved** (the Eraser flag bit 6 is).

regions.name: PASSWORD ENCODER (`$83AE`): max life and fire rate (byte 17)
regions.description: `$044A` := `$47` (0 if it is `$FF`) OR `$6B`: the max life in the high five bits (**only its multiples of 8 survive**) and the fire rate `$6B` (0-5) in the low three.

regions.name: PASSWORD ENCODER (`$83AE`): column and attack (byte 18)
regions.description: `$044B` := (`$52` x 8) OR the three bits of (`$4A` - 1), reversed (`$8430`).

regions.name: PASSWORD ENCODER (`$83AE`): row and shield (byte 19)
regions.description: `$044C` := (`$53` x 8) OR the three bits of `$4B`, reversed.

regions.name: PASSWORD ENCODER (`$83AE`): the score, first half (byte 20)
regions.description: The first three score digits `$0170-$0172` as one number 0-999 (`$844D`): the low byte to `$044D`, the top two bits shifted into `$0444` (the copy of `$04AB`) from the bottom.

regions.name: PASSWORD ENCODER (`$83AE`): the score, second half (byte 21)
regions.description: `$0173-$0175` the same: `$044E` and two more bits into `$0444`. **`$04AB` (the corridor flags 17-21) therefore keeps only its low nibble, moved up: the cleared flag of corridor 21 (bit 4) is NOT in the password.** RUN: 300 random states through the ROM's own encoder and decoder came back exactly (apart from the dropped bits above), and `$04AB` = `$10` came back 0.

regions.name: PASSWORD ENCODER (`$83AE`): insert three bits (`$8430`)
regions.description: `$10` := A; then the low three bits of Y are shifted into `$10` from the bottom (`$8439`): `$10` = A x 8 + reverse3(Y); returns A := `$10`.

regions.name: PASSWORD ENCODER (`$83AE`): shift three bits in (`$8439`)
regions.description: Three times `LSR A / ROL $10`.

regions.name: PASSWORD APPLY (`$8473`): extract three bits (`$8443`)
regions.description: `$10` := 0; `JSR $8439`; Y := `$10`: A is shifted right three bits and Y gets those three bits reversed.

regions.name: PASSWORD ENCODER (`$83AE`): three digits to a number (`$844D`)
regions.description: A = the last digit, `$18` = the middle, `$19` = the first: **A (low) and `$18` (high) := 100 x `$19` + 10 x `$18` + A**.

regions.name: PASSWORD APPLY (`$8473`): copy back
regions.description: `$049F + Y` := `$0438 + Y`, Y = 17..1 (the reverse of the encoder's copy).

regions.name: PASSWORD APPLY (`$8473`): clear unsaved bits
PASSWORD APPLY (`$8473`): chip level
regions.description: Four times `LSR $04A8 / ROL A`: **`$46` := the chip level**, and `$04A8` loses those four bits (its saved nibble moves back down).

regions.name: PASSWORD APPLY (`$8473`): fire rate and max life
PASSWORD APPLY (`$8473`): column and attack
regions.description: `$044B` is split by `$8443`: `$7C` := the column, `$4A` := the three bits + 1.

regions.name: PASSWORD APPLY (`$8473`): row and shield
regions.description: `$044C`: `$7D` := the row, `$4B` := the three bits. **The position goes into `$7C/$7D` (the progress record), not `$52/$53`.**

regions.name: PASSWORD APPLY (`$8473`): the score, second half
regions.description: `$04AB`'s bottom two bits (shifted out) and `$044E` give `$0173-$0175` (`$8502`).

regions.name: PASSWORD APPLY (`$8473`): the score, first half
regions.description: The next two bits of `$04AB` and `$044D` give `$0170-$0172`. After the two halves `$04AB` has lost its four top bits' worth: it holds the corridor flags 17-20.

regions.name: PASSWORD APPLY (`$8473`): a number to three digits (`$8502`)
regions.description: A (low) and Y (high): `$C10E` (`$F9BA`) divides by 100 (hundreds digit -> `$19`), `$C10B` (`$F9AE`) divides the rest by 10: A := tens, Y := ones.
